source_result.metric_normalization: Per-packet mean over24 real residual coordinates; ratio of pooled sums on identical visible-valid packets. Invalid packets explicitly counted; never selected by hidden-target energy.

relation_summary.relation_plan: all 4 other RX x 5 other TX at the same day and original within-cell ordinal
relation_summary.grouping: RX/day/TX statistics use anchor metadata; invalid endpoint relations are excluded only by visible-valid flags
relation_summary.pair_statistics: ordered two-endpoint pairs, each counted once per anchor and reference; validity uses only those two endpoints
relation_summary.boundary: seen-source-RX physical residual geometry; not learned-model performance, DG, new-TX identification or causal nuisance evidence; caller asserts data provenance

qualification.rule: >=95% visible-valid; visible mean reduces pooled MSE vs reference by>=10%, no RX negative benefit; fixed same-day cross-RX identity cosine gap>=.02 and positive in>=4/5 RX. Necessary source feasibility only, not DG efficacy or decoder benefit.

source_result.limitation: Seen-source received/equalized reference residual24; not deployed joint160, identifiable TX hardware, raw-noise independence, trained decoder benefit, hiddenU labels or DG/Phase2 performance.
